purpose: Decode a VIN through the United States National Highway Traffic Safety Administration vPIC service to retrieve manufacturer-reported vehicle description attributes.
sections: This optional step sends the VIN you provided to the NHTSA vPIC vehicle information service for decoding.
The lookup may return manufacturer-reported make, model, model year, body class, trim, and other available attributes. Some fields may be unavailable, incomplete, or inaccurate.

Claim2Car records the normalized returned attributes, the provider name, lookup time, and a digest of the provider response. Claim2Car does not retain the raw VIN or the raw provider response in the vehicle profile record.

A decoded profile is not proof of ownership, vehicle authenticity, physical condition, damage, curb weight, or roadworthiness. It is not by itself an input eligible for crash physics or damage conclusions.
You may decline this optional lookup without blocking ordinary evidence capture. You may withdraw this permission; retained profile attributes will then be cleared from the active vehicle profile.
The lookup is performed only after you explicitly accept this separate disclosure. It is distinct from consent to capture photographs and vehicle condition evidence.
